sources.t: Mobile connectivity you can count on
sources.f: Published 3 June 2026; Ofcom sets out current mobile-quality findings and improvement work, including rail and consumer-experience research.
sources.g: National and route-level research does not prove mobile or fixed service at an exact parcel.

sources.t: Comparing customer service: choosing the best home broadband, mobile and landline provider
sources.f: The official HTML page presents provider customer-service comparisons and records an April 2026 data resubmission affecting selected historic fault figures.
sources.g: Customer-service comparison is not physical network reach or current address orderability evidence.

sources.t: July 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK publishes a contract-level snapshot held on 16 July with initial-scope and ingestion-lag qualifications.
sources.g: Administrative snapshots are not live exact-premises service checks.

sources.t: June 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK reports June contract-level progress and warns that ingestion lag prevents milestone assessment.
sources.g: Contract aggregates require fresh UPRN and provider validation before parcel promotion.

sources.t: May 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK notes supplier data resubmissions and limits affecting comparisons between releases.
sources.g: Revised management information is not a current retail-orderability check.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Derbyshire Peak District
sources.f: Updated 10 April 2026; the original FullFibre contract ended and the area was moved into an Openreach call-off arrangement.
sources.g: Termination and replacement-contract status do not establish completed service at an address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Shropshire
sources.f: Updated 14 April 2026; the page records descoping of the Freedom Fibre contract and later Openreach call-off coverage.
sources.g: Descope and call-off records are programme evidence, not exact parcel availability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Teesdale
sources.f: The official guidance records the Teesdale contract award and explains that detailed planning precedes service availability.
sources.g: Awarded scope and anticipated build do not prove current orderability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Northumberland
sources.f: The guidance records the North Northumberland award and explicitly notes that premises scope may change after detailed planning.
sources.g: Planned contract scope is not exact current service evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cumbria
sources.f: The guidance records the Cumbria award and distinguishes planning and network construction from the later ability to request service.
sources.g: Contract and build plans do not prove a completed retail connection at a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - New Forest
sources.f: The official page records the New Forest award and reasons why premises may sit outside planned contract build.
sources.g: Regional contract scope cannot substitute for current address-level validation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract - Borders and East Lothian
sources.f: Published 21 February 2025; the page records a Scottish Government contract for premises across Borders and East Lothian.
sources.g: A contract award is not proof of completed or orderable service at an individual premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract - North East Scotland
sources.f: Published 15 July 2025; the page records the regional Scottish Government contract for North East Scotland.
sources.g: Regional procurement evidence does not establish live parcel connectivity.

sources.t: Project Gigabit: East Sussex Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the consultation page publishes East Sussex closure and postcode outcome materials.
sources.g: Public Review classifications combine historic existing and planned coverage.

sources.t: Project Gigabit - Greater London Lot 37 Public Review
sources.f: The consultation sought evidence on existing gigabit networks and future commercial build plans in Greater London.
sources.g: Consultation inputs and planned coverage are not live retail availability checks.

sources.t: Project Gigabit: West Sussex Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the page records the West Sussex Public Review process and outcome material.
sources.g: Historic intervention mapping requires fresh provider and UPRN validation.

sources.t: Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire and East of Berkshire Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the closure notice documents OMR and Public Review outcomes and post-closure updates.
sources.g: Classification and intervention-area records do not confirm present service at a premises.

sources.t: Closure of the Release 1B Public Review RFI Consultation
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the notice records closure of the 2021 Release 1B review covering Suffolk, Norfolk, Shropshire and Hampshire areas.
sources.g: Historic review closure and proposed intervention scope are not current orderability evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit progress update - November 2024
sources.f: The official update summarises the contract and procurement pipeline as of November 2024.
sources.g: A dated programme pipeline is not exact present-day parcel truth.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Delivery Plan - autumn update 2022
sources.f: The official delivery update records early awards and the programme's intention to adapt interventions to market changes.
sources.g: Historic delivery plans and intended scope cannot establish current serviceability.
